Drishyam 3 Hindi Franchise to Conclude, Director Confirms

Director Abhishek Pathak has confirmed that the Hindi version of the film franchise "Drishyam" will conclude with its third installment, "Drishyam 3: The Conclusion." Pathak stated that this Hindi version will be entirely different from its Malayalam original. He also mentioned that actor Akshaye Khanna had a sudden exit from the project a week before shooting commenced, a decision the filmmakers were "not happy" with.
